collections.title: Curated Collections
collections.description: Distinct portfolios defined by mineral pigmentation, deep resin casting depth, and hand-rubbed botanical finishes.

masterworks.title: Masterwork Creations
masterworks.description: One-of-a-kind art pieces crafted in limited studio runs. Reserved for collectors and architectural spaces.

philosophy.title: The Alchemy of Ancient Wood & Crystal Resin
philosophy.description: At Galassia Epoxy Design, we reject mass production in favor of meticulous craft. Every commission begins with salvaging venerable timber — centuries-old olive, black walnut, and spalted maple — carefully stabilized over months of controlled moisture drying.

steps.title: Zero-VOC Museum Grade Resins
steps.body: All small-batch formulas are tested on real archival and museum test decades of lightfastness.

steps.title: Bespoke Custom Pigments & Gold Foils
steps.body: Every heavy mineral swirl is hand-stirred, with certain spatial gems and 24K leaf foil available.

steps.title: Direct WhatsApp Artisan Consultation
steps.body: Work directly with the lead designer from concept sketch to final inspection.

cta.title: Dreaming of a bespoke centerpiece for your space?
cta.description: Connect directly with our master resin craftsmen on WhatsApp to discuss custom dimensions, live-edge wood selection, and personalized metallic color palettes.
